title: StackBraid / Background jobs
description: Job duration and failures emitted by both backends' background workers. The workers record OpenTelemetry instruments `stackbraid.jobs.duration` (histogram, unit s, attributes `job.type` and `job.outcome`) and `stackbraid.jobs.failures` (counter, attributes `job.type` and `job.reason`); the queries below name their Prometheus-normalized forms (`_seconds_bucket`, `_total`). Emission is verified via the console exporter; this dashboard has not been seen rendering against a live Prometheus/Grafana, which cannot run in this repository's no-Docker test environment.

panels.title: Job duration (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of time a background job attempt took, across both backends.

panels.title: Job attempts by outcome
panels.description: Attempts per second, tagged succeeded / retrying / dead-lettered.

panels.title: Job failures
panels.description: Failed attempts per second, tagged by job type and reason (handler-error or no-handler).
